parent_objective: audit no-training fixed-mask residual component sensitivity evidence

public_gates: M793 audits M792 without replay rerun
M793 checks whether steer residual is both useful and harmful
M793 checks whether fixed masks are actionable
M793 decides whether to design steer-specific calibration or stop residual calibration
M793 blocks training PPO and promotion
forbidden_shortcuts: do not weaken M786 or M780 comparison thresholds after seeing M792
do not treat M792 fixed public corpus as broad generalization
do not add oracle deploy-time inputs

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits fixed-mask component evidence and decides whether residual calibration should continue with steer-specific boundary handling
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: audit decision only; no training PPO or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if M792 artifacts are inconsistent with the registered no-training invariants
stop if no component evidence supports a next residual-calibration design
stop if the next proposed branch would only tune fixed public masks without fresh evidence
fallback_plan: if M792 is a tooling artifact, repair M792 before interpretation
if fixed masks are insufficient but steer attribution is robust, design steer-specific normal-boundary calibration
if attribution is weak, stop residual calibration and return to corpus or architecture evidence
if attribution is strong but public-corpus overfit risk is high, design fresh source or trajectory-time audit before training
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M792 produced attribution_found with no actionable fixed mask

hypothesis: M792 provides enough clean component evidence to choose the next residual-calibration branch without training or promotion.
success_criteria: M793 documents supported and falsified claims from M792
M793 classifies whether M792 is actionable, attribution-only, or blocked
M793 keeps PPO and promotion blocked
failure_criteria: audit claims broad generalization from the public M773 corpus

commands.name: audit
commands.command: write docs/m793-v4-residual-component-sensitivity-audit.md from M792 artifacts; no training command

decision_rule: M793 may only audit M792 and select the next blocker. It must not train, run PPO, mutate actor or residual parameters, or promote a checkpoint.
